HyperparamGridSpec.description:
A discrete grid: each named axis maps to the values it should sweep.

Grid is the only supported strategy in this slice (Random / Hyperband /
Bayesian are intentionally out of scope). Axis names are dotted ``actionConfig``
paths (e.g. ``validation.stability_dmp_freq``) applied as per-trial overlays.

axes.description: Map of actionConfig overlay path to the discrete values to sweep. Operator-set per search from the portal; the Cartesian product defines the trials.
axes.title: Axes

HyperparamGridSpec.title: HyperparamGridSpec

ObjectiveWeights.description:
Maximize scalar J = (weighted sum of performance terms) + (optional stability rewards).

For loss-like metrics (NLL, Brier, ECE), a **positive** weight *subtracts* ``w * value``.
If a weighted metric is absent (e.g. no NLL in detector-only summaries), that term is skipped;
if **required** (non-zero w for BA or macro_f1) and missing, the run is infeasible.
